name: Saiga Michiru
source:
She is the wife of a junior colleague at work, in her early 20s.  She is a former “gyaru” type, and has an infant child. She has an infant child. 

She is bored with her current life and can't got out and play like she used to because of her child.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/gokuraku/joshibuka/michiru.html]official site[/url]]
